# Trans Canada Trail

> > Canada's National Trail – the world's longest recreational trail network connecting communities from the Pacific to the Atlantic to the Arctic

Trans Canada Trail maintains and develops accessible trail infrastructure across Canada, partnering with government, Indigenous communities, and organizations like KEEN Footwear and Columbia Sportswear. The organization focuses on trail accessibility, maintenance, community engagement, and outdoor recreation while securing funding through donations and federal support.

## Key Topics

- Trans Canada Trail
- Canadian trail network
- Trail accessibility and inclusion
- Trail maintenance and infrastructure
- P'tit Train du Nord (Quebec)
- Meewasin Trail (Saskatchewan)
- Chief Isadore Trail (British Columbia)
- Outdoor recreation activities
- Trail funding and donations
- Wayfinding and navigation
- Indigenous trail partnerships
- Trail safety guidelines
- Community engagement
- Neuro-inclusive design
- Government of Canada trail support

## Trail Information & Activities

- [Trans Canada Trail | Canada's National Trail](https://tctrail.ca): Homepage for Trans Canada Trail, world's longest recreational trail network
- [Trans Canada Trail | Where to enjoy nature on the Trans Canada Trail](https://tctrail.ca/activities/nature): Nature activity guide featuring trail sections like P'tit Train du Nord
- [Trans Canada Trail | Where to bike on the Trans Canada Trail](https://tctrail.ca/activities/pedal): Biking guide with cycling routes and itinerary recommendations

## Accessibility & Inclusive Design

- [Trans Canada Trail | All Persons Trail: Neuro-Inclusive Trail Design](https://tctrail.ca/all-persons-trail-neuro-inclusive-trail-design): Neuro-inclusive design guidelines for neurodivergent trail accessibility
- [Trans Canada Trail | All Persons Trail: Tactile Elements & Sensory Gardens](https://tctrail.ca/all-persons-trail-tactile-elements-sensory-gardens): Guide to tactile and sensory trail features for immersive experiences
- [Trans Canada Trail | All Persons Trail: Trail Navigation](https://tctrail.ca/all-persons-trail-trail-navigation): Accessible wayfinding and navigation guidelines with braille signage

## Partnerships & Collaboration

- [Trans Canada Trail | A Story of Collaboration](https://tctrail.ca/a-story-of-collaboration): KEEN Footwear partnership powering Great Trail app with 60K+ downloads
- [Trans Canada Trail | The Power of Partnerships](https://tctrail.ca/annual-report-2021-2022/the-power-of-partnerships): 2021-2022 partnerships overview with Columbia Sportswear and Peace by Chocolate

## Annual Reports & Governance

- [Trans Canada Trail | A message from Michael Lindsay Chair, Trans Canada Trail Board of Directors](https://tctrail.ca/annual-report-2022-2023/a-message-from-michael-lindsay): Board Chair Michael Lindsay's message on trail's civic importance
- [Trans Canada Trail | Governance](https://tctrail.ca/annual-report-2022-2023/governance): Organizational structure: board, foundation, Indigenous advisory committee
- [Trans Canada Trail | Year in Review April – June 2022](https://tctrail.ca/annual-report-2022-2023/april-june-2022): Q1 2022 highlights: $55M federal funding and Peace by Chocolate partnership
- [Trans Canada Trail | Year in Review January – March 2023](https://tctrail.ca/annual-report-2022-2023/january-march-2023): Q1 2023 review: Blahs to Ahhhs campaign and Trail Talk Live launch
